import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
# Note: Correct the function name to match the actual GSL function for FFT
# Assuming the function is gsl_fft_complex_radix2_forward (as an example)
fft_complex_radix2_forward = gsl.gsl_fft_complex_radix2_forward
fft_complex_radix2_forward.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
fft_complex_radix2_forward.restype = ctypes.c_int

# Helper function to convert complex array to ctypes
def complex_array_to_ctypes(arr):
    real_imag = np.empty(2 * len(arr), dtype=np.float64)
    real_imag[0::2] = arr.real
    real_imag[1::2] = arr.imag
    return real_imag.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))

# Main function to perform FFT
def perform_fft(in_array, n):
    # Prepare the input array
    data = complex_array_to_ctypes(in_array)
    # Call the GSL FFT function
    result_code = fft_complex_radix2_forward(data, 1, n)
    if result_code != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"FFT computation failed with error code {result_code}")
    # Convert back to numpy array
    out_array = np.empty_like(in_array)
    out_array.real = np.ctypeslib.as_array(data, shape=(2*n,))[0::2]
    out_array.imag = np.ctypeslib.as_array(data, shape=(2*n,))[1::2]
    return out_array

# Assertion tests
def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Simple FFT
    in_array = np.array([1+1j, 2+2j, 3+3j, 4+4j], dtype=np.complex128)
    result = perform_fft(in_array, 4)
    expected = np.fft.fft(in_array)
    assert np.allclose(result, expected), f"Test case 1 failed: {result} != {expected}"

    # Test case 2: Larger FFT
    in_array = np.random.random(8) + 1j * np.random.random(8)
    result = perform_fft(in_array, 8)
    expected = np.fft.fft(in_array)
    assert np.allclose(result, expected), f"Test case 2 failed: {result} != {expected}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
